newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ SPORT - RUGBY UNION - Baabaa tour tags Ieremia next test centre.
newsitem.headline: NZ SPORT - RUGBY UNION - Baabaa tour tags Ieremia next test centre.

text.p: WELLINGTON, Oct 15 - Wellington's Alama Ieremia is keen to hold up his hand for the All Blacks' test centre berth on the Barbarians' short rugby tour to Britain next month, NZPA reports.
With experienced All Blacks Frank Bunce and Walter Little being allowed to rest rather than tour, Ieremia appears certain to play the international against England on Twickenham on November 30.

That could be seen as an indication that he is, in All Blacks coach John Hart's mind, the obvious heir apparent to Bunce, who has played every test since 1992 in the position bar last year's World Cup romp against Japan.
Hart said yesterday that Ieremia had made considerable progress through this year to take a clear edge over Waikato's Scott McLeod as the next test midfield back.
"It's another opportunity, and I have to grab it," said Ieremia, who until now has played at second five-eighth for the All Blacks.
"It's a pretty good side. I wasn't too sure I was going to make it."
Ieremia has been playing at centre for Wellington this season but he still feels something of a novice in the position after initially making his mark as a second-five.
"Apart from the Auckland game I never really had a centre game I was happy with," said Ieremia. "I still need a few games there."
